metadata.title: Subharti University @SubhartiUni Campus Food Walk in Meerut with Team Yuva
metadata.description:
#paidpromotions

One of the cogent memories of our college days, apart from the wonderful camaraderie, mentorship and learnings, is the myriad food available at the campus that satiates not just the tummy but soul. Recently we got an opportunity to relive our college food memories with the amazing group of students and faculty members of Subharti University at their sprawling campus in Meerut. Ranked among the top 10 of Universities in India, Swami Vivekanand Subharti University is NAAC "A" Accredited and has received numerous National and International Awards.

The main campus is strategically situated on Delhi Bypass Road, National Highway 58, Meerut, which falls under Delhi NCR. The campus aptly called 'Subhartipuram', is spread over a sprawling 250 acres of land. With numerous departments, parks, stadiums, cafeterias, health centers, auditoriums etc. and a population of over 6000 staffs and students, it is determined to become a 'Jewel in the Crown' of the nation.

Trying a medley of student favourite dishes in the company of an enthusiastic team of students from different departments, left us impressed. From the samosa to kachori, sandwich to noodles, matra chaat to a hearty meal at one of the mess, everything was delicious. The diversity of cuisines and diligent approach of the teams behind these eateries is highly commendable. We had a gratifying and nostalgic time exploring the wonderful campus and popular eats over here along with a talented bunch of students who are so proud to be associated with the institution. 

Do watch till the end to enjoy some amusing and memorable moments shared with the lovely people over here.
